entities.summary: Ivan Verkhratskyi was a Ukrainian-Galician natural scientist, linguist, and teacher. His most famous scientific works were creating multiple volumes of local plant names in Ukraine, which is still the largest of its kind, and creating the foundational textbooks for zoology and botany in Ukrainian gymnasiums.
